target.title: fix: guard generated video downloads [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating videos from providers that return URL-only assets could have the CLI download provider-supplied URLs without applying the configured provider request network policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The CLI now resolves the selected provider's request policy for URL-only generated video assets and downloads them through the guarded provider HTTP path. This preserves streaming output and in-memory size caps while keeping provider request config as the opt-in path for private-network downloads.

## User Impact

CLI video generation keeps working for normal provider-hosted media, blocks private/internal download targets by default, and still permits configured private-network providers when operators opt into that request policy.

Release-note-style behavior note: URL-only generated video downloads that resolve to private/internal networks now fail closed unless the selected provider already has `models.providers.<provider>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` enabled.

## Evidence

- AI-assisted.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/capability-cli.test.ts` passed: 108 tests.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/cli/capability-cli.ts src/cli/capability-cli.test.ts` passed.
- Live CLI/provider proof outside mocks at `ab40c6ddcaf98ffa6c92965a308681b4edbcbab8`:
  - Command surface exercised: `node openclaw.mjs infer video generate --prompt ... --model pr101854-proof-video/url-only --output <proof-root>/out/... --json`.
  - A temporary OpenClaw video provider was loaded through normal plugin/provider registration and returned URL-only `video/mp4` assets; no Vitest mocks or fetch mocks were used.
  - Public hosted video fixture `https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4`: exit `0`, `capability: video.generate`, `provider: pr101854-proof-video`, output MIME `video/mp4`, output size `1128375` bytes.
  - Private/internal URL with the default selected-provider request policy: exit `1`, private endpoint request count `0`, stderr contained `Blocked hostname or private/internal/special-use IP address`, and the signed query token plus private path were not emitted.
  - Same private/internal URL with `models.providers.pr101854-proof-video.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true`: exit `0`, private endpoint request count `1`, output MIME `video/mp4`, output size `19` bytes.
- Credentialed vendor-provider CLI proof was not included because provider credentials were unavailable. The live proof above targets the changed boundary: the CLI download path after a provider returns a URL-only generated-video asset.
